title: scary storytime
description: "I thought I was alone… until I heard footsteps upstairs. I checked every room. Nothing. Then my phone recorded a whisper at 3AM: 'I’m still here.' I set up a camera… and saw something step out of my closet. It looked exactly like me. Last night, I woke up on the floor… my bed was empty. Every mirror… smiled first."
